description: This file defines custom commit rules for gitlint, including classes for validating commit message body length, presence of 'Signed-off-by' lines, title length, title format, line length with exceptions, and blocked tags.

classes.name: BodyMinLineCount
classes.description: CommitRule that enforces a minimum number of lines in the commit message body, excluding 'Signed-off-by' lines.

classes.name: BodyMaxLineCount
classes.description: CommitRule that enforces a maximum number of lines in the commit message body.

classes.name: SignedOffBy
classes.description: CommitRule that checks for the presence and proper format of 'Signed-off-by' lines in the commit message.

classes.name: TitleMaxLengthRevert
classes.description: LineRule that enforces maximum length on commit titles, excluding reverts.

classes.name: TitleStartsWithSubsystem
classes.description: LineRule that enforces commit titles to match a specified regex pattern.

classes.name: MaxLineLengthExceptions
classes.description: LineRule that enforces maximum line length in commit message body, with exceptions for URLs and certain prefixes.

classes.name: BodyContainsBlockedTags
classes.description: LineRule that blocks specific tags like 'Change-Id' in commit message body.

methods.name: validate
methods.description: Method implemented in each class to perform specific validation on commit message or lines.
